title: Brand Identity | Oliga Rose
description: Olga Rose was developed as a complete branding journey, starting from the core logo design and extending through to the full packaging system. Every element was carefully crafted to reflect a cohesive visual identity that communicates elegance, consistency, and brand character across all touchpoints. The result is a refined and unified brand experience that brings the Olga Rose vision to life in a clear and memorable way.
